component.name: JustQuran
component.summary: Read and listen to the Quran in Arabic, English and Urdu

description.p: JustQuran is a clean, modern reader for the Holy Quran, presented in Arabic together with Urdu and English translations. It is free and open source, with no adverts, no subscriptions, no tracking and no account.

ul.li: Arabic in the Digital Khatt IndoPak script, in a paged mushaf layout
Urdu translation by Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari
English: The ClearQuran translation by Dr Talal Itani
Paged mushaf view with waqf symbols, surah headers and bismillah markers
Verse-by-verse cards showing Arabic, translation and transliteration side by side
Arabic recitation by Sheikh Mahmoud Khalil Al-Hussary, with English and Urdu narration, verse by verse or continuously like an audiobook
Book view for the English and Urdu translations, highlighting the verse being read
Fast offline search across Arabic, English and Urdu
Surah and juz indexes, bookmarks and the Khatm al-Quran supplication
Light, dark and sepia themes with separate text sizes for each language

description.p: All texts, translations and fonts are included, so reading needs no internet connection. The network is used only to stream or download audio.
